title: Four receiving-system readings deepen the existing Place Atlas
summary: The Southwest chip corridor, Hanford, Space Coast and Northern Virginia now have separately scoped place narratives from retained dated inspections. Regional, site, policy and project evidence remain distinct.
evidence_note: Twenty-four sections reuse nineteen exact source-check records from five saved receipts. November 22 is authorship and AI self-review, not an external inspection. Source dates, failures and scope limits remain attached. Original Atlas and portfolio inputs and all existing evidence receipts are unchanged.
publication_effect: No new counted identities, place stages, project-stage changes or operating outcomes. Eligibility remains 100 projects and 70 places. Production, release, owner launch and actual stewardship remain open.
